verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at better-auth.com, and a second probe confirms the docs are served as raw markdown (.md) pages that an agent can ingest directly. First-party AI-resources docs also describe a hosted remote MCP server that gives MCP clients documentation search, examples, and setup help. Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents actually using these docs, and evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.better-auth.com/llms.txt # Better Auth
Better Auth hosts a remote MCP server that exposes documentation search, examples, and setup help to any MCP-capable client (Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, Open Code, and others).
